descriptions.text: Enchanted Spiked Kneepads of the Shade Gnoll Riot Forces. Adds 10% Damage Reflect to all equipped armor. Cancels all Momentum-based attacks. Made of skin and fur and the spiky things from the back of Thorn Cadavers, these kneepads are both good protection and they’re stylish. Stylish, that is, if your knees are cosplaying as hedgehogs.

beats.headline: Something on his legs
beats.text: In a tutorial guild after the Hoarder, the last of Carl's boxes is a gold crowd control box: three scrolls, five Iron Skin potions, and the kneepads. They are the real prize. It isn't pants, but it is something on his legs. He pulls his feet through them like slip-on bracers; they look much too small and adjust themselves. The spikes are thin and needle-like, about eight inches each, and retract until they are needed. Donut asks Mordecai whether the dungeon has a worst-dressed award. Sort of, he says.

beats.headline: The slime kills itself
beats.text: Near the northern edge of the Hoarder's neighbourhood, Carl punches a level two green slime the size of a pig and sinks into it up to the elbow. His right fingerless glove dissolves off his hand and the right arm of his leather jacket melts away. The slime kills itself on his Damage Reflect. His arm comes out red, bubbling and screaming with pain.

beats.headline: Not enough knee
beats.text: Locked in close with Gore-Gore, the mantaur engineer, Carl is too tight to kick, so he knees him with a spiked kneepad. He can tell the power just isn't there, and he has to punch twice more to get clear. When Gore-Gore's three razors tear across Carl's face, the mantaur grunts in surprise as the damage reflection hits him.

beats.headline: Spikes for a ghoul
beats.text: The engine ploughs through a tunnel packed with ghouls, and pieces of them shower into the cab. Carl smashes a gnashing head with his fist and it explodes. Another chomps painfully onto his leg. He pushes it down, the kneepads activate, and the spikes kill it. The train whines and noticeably slows while Donut screams and slices with her claws.

beats.headline: Outside the kangaroo
beats.text: Carl shoves his arms into the stinking kangaroo costume and pulls its head over his own. There is a loud click and an achievement. His jacket stays on the inside, his cloak flaps round his neck, and his boxers and kneepads are now on the outside of the costume.

beats.headline: Tiny on a dachshund
beats.text: Elle is a goblin, Jacobus a starfish, and Carl a long-haired dachshund with a German accent and no thumbs. His boxers have resized themselves and sit awkwardly on his hips. Jacket, cloak and bandanna remain; none of his rings do, and the xistera and the gauntlet have unequipped themselves. The kneepads remain, tiny on his back legs.
